about.subtitle: Rwanda Muslim Community — Building a United Ummah

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To unite and serve the Muslim community in Rwanda through digital innovation, promoting Islamic values, education, and social welfare.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A digitally empowered, unified, and prosperous Muslim community contributing to the development of Rwanda.

history.title: Our History
history.text: The Rwanda Muslim Community has been serving Muslims across Rwanda since its founding. With a network spanning all provinces and districts, RMC coordinates religious, educational, and social services for over 500,000 Muslims nationwide.

values.title: Core Values
values.unityDesc: Bringing Muslims together across all regions of Rwanda
values.educationDesc: Promoting Islamic and secular education for all members
values.serviceDesc: Providing essential services to community members in need
values.transparencyDesc: Open and accountable governance of community resources

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.subtitle: Guided by dedicated leaders committed to serving the community

m1.desc: Provides spiritual guidance and leads the strategic direction of the community.

m2.desc: Supports leadership and oversees coordination across provinces and districts.

m3.desc: Manages administration, communication, and day-to-day operations.

m4.desc: Leads educational, social, and development initiatives nationwide.

areas.religiousDesc: Mosque coordination, imam training, Da'wah, and religious guidance.
areas.educationDesc: Islamic and secular schools, scholarships, and Qur'an education.
areas.socialDesc: Support for families in need, orphans, and vulnerable members.
areas.financeDesc: Zakat collection and distribution, and community financial support.
areas.healthDesc: Health awareness, support programs, and access to care.
areas.youthDesc: Youth empowerment, leadership, and community engagement programs.

whoWeAre.heading: One Ummah,
whoWeAre.p1: The Rwanda Muslim Community (RMC) is the national umbrella organization representing and serving Muslims across all provinces of Rwanda. We coordinate religious, educational, and social services for a community of over 500,000 people.
whoWeAre.p2: Rooted in the principles of Islamic brotherhood, RMC works hand in hand with mosques, schools, and local leaders to build a thriving, self-reliant, and digitally empowered Ummah.
whoWeAre.point1: Present in all 5 provinces and 30 districts
whoWeAre.point3: Faith, education, and welfare under one roof

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: Key milestones in the journey of the Rwanda Muslim Community

e1.title: Foundations
e1.text: Local Muslim associations across Rwanda begin coordinating to serve their communities with a shared vision.

e2.title: National Unity
e2.text: Communities unite under one national body, establishing RMC as the umbrella organization for Muslims in Rwanda.

e3.title: Growth & Education
e3.text: Expansion of Islamic schools, mosques, and social programs reaching every province and district.

e4.title: Digital Transformation
e4.text: RMC embraces technology to connect members, share knowledge, and deliver services online.

e5.title: A Thriving Ummah
e5.text: Serving over 500,000 Muslims with religious, educational, financial, and social services nationwide.

services.title: Community Services

marriage.title: Marriage Services
marriage.desc: Official Islamic marriage ceremonies, certificates, and documentation for couples in the community.

detail.overviewP1: RMC guides couples through every step of the Islamic marriage (Nikah) — from pre-marital guidance to a properly officiated ceremony and official documentation. Our scholars ensure the marriage is conducted fully in accordance with Islamic law.
detail.overviewP2: Whether you are starting your application or simply learning what is involved, we make the process clear, dignified, and stress-free for both families.
detail.includesSubtitle: Everything you need for a complete and recognised Islamic marriage.

nikah.title: Nikah Ceremony
nikah.text: A complete Islamic marriage ceremony officiated by a qualified imam in accordance with the Sunnah.

certificate.title: Official Certificate
certificate.text: A recognised RMC marriage certificate issued and registered for both partners.

guidance.title: Pre-Marital Guidance
guidance.text: Counselling sessions covering rights, responsibilities, and building a strong Islamic household.

witness.title: Witness & Mahr Support
witness.text: Assistance arranging witnesses and documenting the agreed mahr (dowry) correctly.

detail.processSubtitle: Five simple steps from application to certificate.

s1.title: Register as a member
s1.text: Both partners create or confirm their RMC membership accounts.

s2.title: Submit your application
s2.text: Provide personal details, guardian (wali) information, and choose a preferred date.

s3.title: Document verification
s3.text: RMC reviews your identity documents and confirms eligibility for the Nikah.

s4.title: Pre-marital counselling
s4.text: Attend a short guidance session with an RMC scholar before the ceremony.

s5.title: Nikah & certification
s5.text: The ceremony is performed and your official marriage certificate is issued.

detail.requirementsSubtitle: Prepare these documents before applying to keep your Nikah on schedule.

requirements.r1: Valid national ID or passport for both partners
requirements.r4: Proof of RMC membership for both partners

f1.q: How long does the process take?
f1.a: Once your documents are verified, the Nikah can usually be scheduled within 1-2 weeks depending on availability.

f2.a: Yes. Both partners must be registered RMC members so the marriage can be properly documented and certified.

f3.a: The RMC certificate is recognised within the community and serves as proof of an Islamic marriage. For civil registration, follow your local authority's process.

f4.q: Can the ceremony be held at our own venue?
f4.a: Yes. Subject to imam availability, the Nikah can be conducted at a mosque, your home, or another agreed venue.

detail.ctaSubtitle: Register as an RMC member to start your marriage application and book your ceremony.

fees.title: Service fees
fees.subtitle: The marriage service fee depends on where the ceremony is held.
fees.clause: The applicable fee must be paid in full before the official marriage certificate is issued. The fee is determined solely by the location of the ceremony — 30,000 RWF within a mosque and 200,000 RWF at any other venue.

apply.title: Marriage Application
apply.subtitle: Fill in the details below to apply for your Islamic marriage certificate.

aside.heading: Begin your blessed union
aside.text: Your application is reviewed by RMC and a qualified imam before your Nikah is scheduled. Please make sure every detail matches your official documents.
aside.p1: Both partners must be registered RMC members
aside.p2: National ID numbers are 16 digits long
aside.p3: Your photo will appear on the official certificate

apply.witnessNote: Provide the National ID number of two adult Muslim witnesses.
apply.officiantHint: Name of the imam or sheikh who will conduct the Nikah.
apply.photoHint: Clear passport-style photo — JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
apply.successText: Thank you. RMC has received your marriage application and will contact you to confirm the details and schedule your Nikah.
apply.venueNote: Your fee depends on where the Nikah takes place.
apply.paymentNote: The fee must be paid in full before your certificate is issued.
apply.payBankSub: Pay to the RMC bank account
apply.amountSelectVenue: Select a location to see the fee
apply.idSavePrompt: Save this ID — you'll need it to check your application status.

status.title: Check application status
status.subtitle: Enter your application ID to see the latest status of your marriage application.
status.notFoundText: We couldn't find an application with that ID. Please check the ID and try again.

stageDesc.review: RMC and the imam are reviewing your application.
stageDesc.approved: Your application is approved — your Nikah can be scheduled.
stageDesc.ready: Your marriage certificate is ready for collection.
